suppress.notes: JRuby 9.4.15.0 is the latest release in the current 9.x line used by this project. CVE-2023-50572 remains in bundled JLine 2.14.6; no newer stable JLine 2 release is available. CVE-2026-56740 and CVE-2026-56741 are false positives: they affect the JLine 3 remote-telnet module, whose TelnetIO and ConnectionData classes are absent from this JLine 2 jar. References: https://github.com/jline/jline3/security/advisories/GHSA-47qp-hqvx-6r3f https://github.com/jline/jline3/security/advisories/GHSA-2r2c-cx56-8933

Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires a major-line upgrade from Jetty 10, which is outside this Java 21 migration and must be handled by the separate dependency-modernization effort.
